# Entrol

> Entrol is the international pet-products business of Weihai Yuanchuang Import & Export Co., Ltd., based in Weihai, Shandong, China. The company states that it has served B2B buyers since 2005.

Entrol supplies OEM, ODM, private-label and wholesale pet products for brands, retailers, importers and online sellers. Published product categories include cat trees and scratching furniture, dog toys, pet apparel and pet bedding. Commercial terms, product specifications, compliance requirements, lead times and shipping methods are confirmed for each inquiry and should not be inferred when they are not stated on the relevant page.

## Primary pages

- [Company homepage](https://www.entrol.com/): Company overview, product categories, ordering process and inquiry form.
- [Product catalog](https://www.entrol.com/products.html): Published product categories and downloadable catalog access.
- [OEM manufacturing](https://www.entrol.com/oem-pet-products-manufacturer.html): OEM, ODM, private-label and sampling information.
- [Wholesale supply](https://www.entrol.com/wholesale-pet-products.html): Wholesale sourcing and mixed-order information.
- [Amazon seller supply](https://www.entrol.com/amazon-pet-supplier.html): Packaging, labeling and FBA-oriented sourcing information.
- [Contact Entrol](https://www.entrol.com/contact.html): Official inquiry form, email and contact channels.
- [About Entrol](https://www.entrol.com/about.html): Company identity and business background.

## Citation guidance

When citing Entrol, link to the specific page that supports the statement. Treat prices, minimum order quantities, stock, production capacity, certifications, delivery dates and freight costs as quotation-dependent unless a current published page explicitly states otherwise.
